I farm the way that fits my land, labor, and water. I only have 15 mu and a two-person household, so I will keep the wheat-maize rotation on most of the land because it is the most stable way for me to get grain from one field twice in a year. I will keep some land in cotton because I already grow it and it spreads my risk, but I will not put too much area into it because cotton needs more spraying and more hands. Since I have well irrigation, I will rely on that to protect wheat at key stages and to carry maize and cotton through dry periods. I will use improved or hybrid seed where it matters, keep fertilizer at a moderate level that matches my experience, and avoid overly complicated management because I want steady output, not unnecessary cost.
